title: Fluid token interactions causing layout drift on Safari and Firefox mobile - triage
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Summary: Several components (primary button, table rows, and compact chart axes) show position/overflow drift and tap-target shrinkage on Safari iOS and Firefox Android when design tokens change at run-time (theme switch or token scale update). This ticket triages findings from the last visual QA sweep and groups actionable fixes and engineering follow-ups.

Background: During the March cross-browser QA pass we exercised the UI kit under different token scales and platform rendering engines. Repro patterns were observed when token updates are applied without a full reflow (theme swap via CSS variables or runtime token patching). Problems surface most consistently with: fluid spacing tokens, button min-height tokens, table row collapse rules, and chart tick alignment.

Observed behavior (examples):
- Primary button height shrinks ~8-12px on Safari iOS 17.4 after switching to compact token set; text vertically misaligned.
- Table row gutter collapses in Firefox Android when horizontal scrollbar appears, causing clipped cell focus outlines.
- Small bar chart axis labels overlap on mobile Safari when token-scale transitions occur while chart is mounted.
- Touch target hitbox for icon-only buttons is reduced on older Android WebViews.

Immediate impact: Visual regressions in PLG flows (signup modal, billing table) and occasional accessibility tap-target failures. Customer impact: medium (visual regressions + potential a11y issues).

Scope of this ticket: Triage and define fixes across tokens, components, and runtime token application. Produce clear reproduction steps, temporary mitigations, and a prioritized fix list for engineering. Link to follow-up engineering tickets for implementation.

Artifacts: Design repro pages in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UiKit-Fluid-Tokens-QA, Figma variants: https://www.figma.com/file/UIKIT-Fluid-Tokens, Visual QA spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/Fluid-Token-QA, Example PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/2145

Notes: Prioritize fixes that avoid full redesigns; prefer CSS-friendly rules (containment, updated min/max tokens, forced reflow heuristics) and runtime-safe token application patterns.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the repro sandbox (Drive link above) on iOS Safari and Firefox Android
Switch token scale from default to compact using the theme toggle in the top-right
Observe primary button height and text alignment in header and modal flows
On tablet widths, enable horizontal overflow on table list and scroll to force scrollbar in Firefox Android
Trigger a runtime token update via console (window.__UIKIT.applyTokens(compact)) while chart is visible to reproduce axis overlap
expected_behavior: Components should maintain stable layout and hit target sizes across token scale transitions and cross-browser renderers. Token updates should not produce clipped outlines, reduced hitboxes, or axis label overlap. Any necessary reflows should be explicit and controlled by the runtime so UX is predictable.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Repro steps consistent across Safari iOS 17.4 and Firefox Android 116.
2) Patch proposals documented and validated by design + engineering on at least one component (button or table).
3) Temporary mitigations published to the UI Kit changelog and rollout notes.
4) Engineering tickets created for each prioritized fix with estimates.
5) Final verification done on designated device matrix and marked Done in this ticket.
prioritized_fix_list: Lock button min-height to token-based clamp() with fallback to px for WebKit recalculation
Add container paint containment to chart and table wrappers to avoid cross-layer reflow side-effects
Enforce focus-outline rendering using outline-offset and focus-visible polyfill for older FF Android
Adjust table cell min-width rules to avoid collapse when scrollbars appear; add forced reflow hook when horizontal overflow toggles
Update runtime token applier to call requestAnimationFrame + toggle a neutral CSS class to force stable layout after token swap
temporary_mitigation: For immediate release branch: apply a CSS-only patch: clamp-based min-height on buttons, add -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100% on affected containers, and a small reflow shim (requestAnimationFrame toggle) inside the runtime theme switch. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/2178
comments: 2026-03-02 - Marcus Chen: Confirmed button shrink on Safari iOS simulator (iPhone 13). Screenshot attached in Drive. Placing temporary CSS clamp as hotfix candidate.
2026-03-03 - Sofia Martinez: Started cataloging affected components in the QA sheet. Noting that compact token set triggers the issue more reliably than high-contrast themes.
2026-03-05 - Priya Nair (Engineering): Suggested try: toggle contain: paint on chart and table containers — reduces repaint cascades in Canary; will test on FF Android.
2026-03-08 - Ava Patel: Design decision: prefer clamp() token definitions plus explicit px fallback to avoid fractional rounding in WebKit; added to prioritized list.
2026-03-10 - Sofia Martinez: Hotfix PR (#2178) opened and tests added for button visual snapshot on iOS. Requesting review from ENG and QE.
2026-03-11 - QE Team (Ana Duarte): Verified hotfix reduces button height drift on iOS 17.4, but table clipping persists in FF Android — need additional fix.
2026-03-12 - Sofia Martinez: Created ENG follow-ups for table and chart (ENG-4321, ENG-4322). Updating this ticket to track verification steps.
2026-03-12 - Marcus Chen: Note for implementation: ensure token applier does not force reflow on every change; debounce at 120ms and batch updates.
